author: BornToDie
body: I have just been banned for excessive infractions, which i can understand because i do have quite a few, and that is due to the fact that my cousins would log on on to my account and be childish. The problem i have is that i was already have been temp banned for having excessive infractions. Because of my original temp ban I make sure that my account is secure and I don't make any bad comments in chat, unless it is censored. Thank you for your time reading this and i hope i can be unbanned, I would greatly appreciate it.

title: Banned for Excessive Infractions

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

Your account is your responsibility. If your cousins were breaking the rules on this account then there's nothing we can do about it. Nonetheless, I highly suggest you stop breaking the rules as if you continue for much longer your account will be permanently banned.

Regards,
Mango_
